STAGE 1 — design selection for ideation_2 (round_20261102_071156_961).
GOAL: pick one mechanism that uses the training-only behaviour-graph curvature WITHOUT spending codebook resolution, and that differs from the failed CURVALLOC-LORENTZ-RQ and from the other listed prior probes.
READ: the brief's measured failure numbers (kappa_hat=[0,-8.96,-25.55], delta=[0.702,0.298,-1.000], curvature=[0.496,0.743,2.718], rho=[0.0381,0.0312,0.0163], exported support 2/13/56 vs frozen 247/7414/20223, collision 0.998, L1 hit 0.982/0.980, recall 0.041888 vs 0.055537 frozen and 0.065 target); the list of prior selected/probed mechanisms (CURVALLOC-LORENTZ-RQ, poincare-frechet-successor-codebook, CURVCTRL-SID, BRad-RQ, BRANCHCURV-MOEB-RQ, TSG-SID, LORENTZ-SUCCPROFILE-SMOOTH-RQ, behcone-prefix-rq, succboost-geoshift, MIXCURV-FIBRE-RQ, SUCC-GEO-CBTAB, BFRQ-KARCHER-MASS).
OBSERVED: no filesystem read or shell is available (read denied; catalog has only browser/opencode/progress), so the design uses the brief's measurements only, no repo inspection.
REASONING: the failure was a currency error — curvature was spent on the code radius rho_l, so curvature and resolution competed for the same scalar. Route (a) of the brief (curvature as a CONSTRAINT on the assignment) admits a resolution-safe formulation: keep the transport column marginals EQUAL to the Euclidean nearest-code counts of the same batch and level. Then curvature can only permute which item occupies which code; per-level code usage, and therefore the exported support, is bit-for-bit the Euclidean support. Behaviour then has to enter as something other than a scale: it enters as the LOCAL CURVATURE of the Poincare distance (per item-code pair), c_ik = c_l * exp(-a_ik), where a_ik is the fraction of the item's training successors that already occupy code k's community. Removing geometry (Euclidean cost) removes the only channel through which a_ik can act, so geometry-off reproduces the Euclidean plan exactly; removing behaviour (a=0, delta=0) gives a uniform-curvature cost. That is a single connected pathway, one equation, no added trainable parameters and no tunable constant (c0=1 dimensionless, exponent 1 per unit affinity, s_l and tau measured per step).
OPEN: write the minimal specification (psi map, Mobius/artanh distance, per-pair curvature, capacity-frozen Sinkhorn, straight-through) with the frozen-scale cost (24556 items, 24 steps/epoch, 3000 epochs), the leakage boundary, and the four-rank safety note (no rank-0-only collectives; curvature computed offline; per-epoch code table recomputed identically per rank).

STAGE 2 — final idea fixed: CURVCAP-SUCCPLAN.
Mechanism: per-level assignment replaced by a capacity-frozen Sinkhorn transport whose cost is a Poincare distance with PER-PAIR curvature c_ik = c_l*exp(-a_ik), where a_ik is the fraction of the item's top-20 TRAIN successors whose Euclidean level-l code is k, and c_l = exp(-delta_l/2) from the size-shuffle-standardised Ollivier curvature of the train transition quotient graph.
Resolution protection (the answer to the prior failure): column marginals of the transport equal the Euclidean nearest-code counts u_k of the same batch and level, so curvature can only permute items among codes; the per-level usage multiset, and hence the exported support, is exactly the Euclidean one. No radius, no rho_l, no per-level ball scale for codes. This is brief route (a) done with frozen marginals.
Coupling: behaviour lives only in the curvature field and geometry is the only channel through which it can act, so behaviour-off (a=0, delta=0 -> c=1 uniform) and geometry-off (Euclidean cost -> plan equals the Euclidean assignment, a_ik has no channel) both change the core assignment. No new trainable parameters; constants c0=1, exponent 1 per unit affinity, s_l and tau measured per step; curvature detached/offline.
Resolution audit target: keep >= 247/7414/20223 support and beat 0.055537 recall, aiming > 0.065; the historical failure 2/13/56 + 0.998 collisions + 0.041888 is structurally excluded.
Cost: ~108M added MAC/step (~0.22 GFLOP) at B=1023, K=256, d=64, J=10; ~1.0-1.8x the RQ-VAE step; 72k steps -> ~1.6e13 FLOPs, ~10-40 min extra on four cards; schedule < 1 min.
Four-rank safety: profile built offline and read by all ranks; per-epoch Euclidean code table recomputed identically per rank; equal-shape all_gather only; no rank-0-only broadcast or export in the loop.
Full formatted answer (all required labels) is printed in the response; record kept short only because of the 4000-character limit on a single record.
